name: Characters & Victory
description: Characters travel in person: every relocation is a free, marked VIP shuttle that can be escorted, intercepted and destroyed (its passenger dies with it; the ruler travels with decoys). Every colony needs a governor: new characters appear at the capital or the matching academy and travel to their post, the capital trains reserve governors, and a colony left without one declines after six months (no construction, falling output and approval, disrepair, emigration) and needs years to recover. Governors are moved by their skills and the colonies' needs, with suggestions for the player or full automation. The AI uses all of it. (A Galactic Council follows in a later package.)

flags.name: cvVipShuttles
flags.label: VIP shuttles
flags.description: Every character trip is a free VIP shuttle (gold ring on the map, despawns on arrival); the passenger dies if it is destroyed or captured.

flags.name: cvEscorts
flags.label: VIP escorts
flags.description: Idle warships escort important travellers on dangerous routes (automatic for the AI; 'Automate VIP escorts' for the player).

flags.name: cvRulerDecoys
flags.label: Ruler decoys
flags.description: A travelling ruler is joined by identical decoy shuttles; a Steal Operations Map mission reveals the real one.

flags.name: cvGovernors
flags.label: Governors on every colony
flags.description: Each colony needs a governor; vacant colonies decline after six months; reserves are trained at the capital; governors move to where their skills matter.
